Setup

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import pandas.testing as pdt

from rent_project.config import DATA_DIRECTORY
from rent_project.config import ADDRESS_BASE_DIRECTORY
from rent_project.load.addressbase import load_schema_new
```

How to read in AddressBase tile
```{python}
COLUMNS = (
    pd.read_csv(
        DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "address-base-plus" /"addressbase-plus-post-e-39-header.csv",
        header=None,
        dtype=str
    )
    .iloc[0]
    .tolist()
)

INT_COLUMNS = [
    'UPRN','UDPRN','PARENT_UPRN','LOCAL_CUSTODIAN_CODE','BUILDING_NUMBER','SAO_START_NUMBER','SAO_END_NUMBER','PAO_START_NUMBER','PAO_END_NUMBER','USRN','OS_ADDRESS_TOID_VERSION','OS_ROADLINK_TOID_VERSION','OS_TOPO_TOID_VERSION','VOA_CT_RECORD','VOA_NDR_RECORD','MULTI_OCC_COUNT'
]

FLOAT_COLUMNS = ['X_COORDINATE', 'Y_COORDINATE', 'LATITUDE', 'LONGITUDE']

DATE_COLUMNS = [
    'STATE_DATE','LA_START_DATE','LAST_UPDATE_DATE','ENTRY_DATE','RM_START_DATE'
]

STRING_COLUMNS = [
    c for c in COLUMNS
    if c not in INT_COLUMNS + FLOAT_COLUMNS + DATE_COLUMNS
]

DTYPES = {
    **{c: "Int64" for c in INT_COLUMNS},
    **{c: "float64" for c in FLOAT_COLUMNS},
    **{c: "string" for c in STRING_COLUMNS},
}

df1 = pd.read_csv(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "address-base-plus" / "2026" / "extracted" / "TL2500" / "TL2500.csv",
    header=None,
    names=COLUMNS,
    dtype=DTYPES,
    parse_dates=DATE_COLUMNS,
)

df2 = pd.read_csv(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "address-base-plus" / "2026" / "extracted" / "TL3000" / "TL3000.csv",
    header=None,
    names=COLUMNS,
    dtype=DTYPES,
    parse_dates=DATE_COLUMNS
)

```

How to load and combine
```{python}
csv_paths = sorted(
    Path(
        DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "address-base-plus" / "2026" / "extracted"
    )
    .rglob("*.csv")
)

len(csv_paths)

df_combined = pd.concat([df1, df2], ignore_index=True)
```

Examine merged AddressBase 2026
```{python}

schema = load_schema_new(DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "address-base-plus" / "addressbase-plus-post-e-39-header.csv")

addressbase2026 = pd.read_csv(
    ADDRESS_BASE_DIRECTORY / "2026" / "greater_london_2026_abplus.csv",
    dtype=schema["dtypes"],
    parse_dates=schema["date_columns"]
)

# Is there anything outside Greater London?
print(addressbase2026['ADMINISTRATIVE_AREA'].value_counts())

```

Comparing schemes
```{python}
old = pd.read_csv(
    ADDRESS_BASE_DIRECTORY / "addressbase-plus-pre-e-39-header.csv",header=None,dtype=str).iloc[0].tolist()
new = pd.read_csv(
    ADDRESS_BASE_DIRECTORY / "addressbase-plus-post-e-39-header.csv",header=None,dtype=str).iloc[0].tolist()

extra_in_old = list(set(old) - set(new))
print(extra_in_old)

extra_in_new = list(set(new) - set(old))
print(extra_in_new)

```
